note: Suppressions for scripts/audit-gate.mts. Every entry is a decision someone has to make again on its expiry date: an entry past `expires` FAILS the build, exactly like an unreviewed advisory. Deleting an expired entry without re-reading it is the failure mode this file exists to make visible, so keep the reason specific enough that the next reader can check it.

entries.reason: Four inherited libvips CVEs in sharp <0.35.0. sharp reaches Rally only as an optional dependency of next, and the only code path that loads it is the Image Optimization endpoint /_next/image. Rally renders zero next/image components (grep: the sole is components/rally-nav.tsx:148, a plain tag on a GitHub avatar URL) and next.config.ts now sets images.unoptimized, which switches that endpoint off, so sharp is never required at runtime. Reaching the libvips decoders would additionally require an attacker-supplied image served from Rally's own origin: no remotePatterns are configured, so remote URLs are rejected, and Rally has no image upload anywhere. The fix is sharp >=0.35.0, which next 16.2.12 forbids (it declares optionalDependencies.sharp '^0.34.5'); forcing it through an npm override is a 0.x major bump outside the parent's declared range and is deliberately NOT applied here. FLAGGED FOR A HUMAN: take sharp >=0.35.0 the moment a next release widens that range, and drop this entry.
